sn22.138:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yam bhikkhave aniccam tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || Rūpam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Vedanā || || Saññā || || {Saṅkhārā} || || Viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ || tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo ti || ||
